title: Verkehrsunfall mit Fahrerflucht – Polizei bittet um Mithilfe

extraction.summaryEn: A car ran a red light at the Kreuzbergstraße/Großbeerenstraße junction at about 5:35 a.m. and crashed head-on into a waiting Hyundai; the driver was injured and the two occupants of the first car fled on foot. Police are asking witnesses to come forward.
